title: SecureClaw: Clawing Back Control of LLM Agents
title_zh: SecureClaw：夺回对 LLM Agent 的控制权
abstract_en: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents face two distinct security failures: unauthorized external actions and exposure of sensitive plaintext inside the runtime before any final output check can intervene. Existing defenses usually protect one boundary, either the planner/runtime or the action sink, and therefore do not by themselves secure both surfaces. We present SecureClaw, a dual-boundary architecture that places authorization at the effect sink and plaintext confinement at the read boundary. Sensitive reads pass through a trusted gateway that replaces raw values with opaque handles and, in the evaluated deployment, bounded summaries as an explicit declassification interface. Writes that change external state follow a PREVIEW$\rightarrow$COMMIT protocol in which only a trusted executor may commit the exact canonical request authorized by policy. The runtime can still plan over summaries and symbolic references, but cannot directly dereference secrets or perform side effects. Across AgentDojo, AgentLeak, and Agent Security Bench (ASB), SecureClaw is the only defense we evaluate in a common harness that simultaneously retains usable task utility and achieves 0\% attack success rate (ASR) on ASB, 0.64\% ASR on AgentDojo, and 3.23\% overall leak on AgentLeak's attacked parity lane, which measures final-output and internal-relay leakage.
abstract_zh: 使用工具的 LLM agents 面临两类安全失效：未经授权的外部动作，以及在最终输出检查介入前，运行时内部敏感明文的暴露。现有防御通常只保护单一边界，即 planner/runtime 或 action sink，因此无法同时覆盖两类攻击面。SecureClaw 提出一种双边界架构：在效果汇点（effect sink）执行授权，在读取边界（read boundary）约束明文。敏感读取必须经过可信网关，将原始值替换为不透明句柄（opaque handles），并在评测部署中通过有界摘要作为显式解密/解分类接口（declassification interface）。会改变外部状态的写操作遵循 PREVIEW→COMMIT 协议，只有可信执行器才能提交经策略授权的精确规范化请求。运行时仍可基于摘要和符号引用进行规划，但不能直接解引用秘密或产生副作用。在 AgentDojo、AgentLeak 和 Agent Security Bench (ASB) 上，SecureClaw 是作者在统一评测框架中唯一同时保持可用任务效用并实现强安全性的防御：ASB 攻击成功率 0%，AgentDojo 攻击成功率 0.64%，AgentLeak attacked parity lane 总体泄漏率 3.23%，该指标同时衡量最终输出泄漏与内部中继泄漏。
key_points_zh: SecureClaw 同时防御两类风险：未授权外部动作与运行时敏感明文泄漏，而不是只保护单一边界。
在读取侧引入可信网关，将秘密替换为 opaque handles，并用 bounded summaries 作为受控 declassification 接口。
在写入侧采用 PREVIEW→COMMIT 协议，确保只有可信执行器能提交被策略授权的精确 canonical request。
LLM runtime 仍可利用摘要和符号引用完成规划，但无法直接访问秘密或执行真实副作用。
在 AgentDojo、AgentLeak、ASB 的统一评测中，SecureClaw 保持任务可用性，并取得 ASB 0% ASR、AgentDojo 0.64% ASR、AgentLeak 3.23% 总体泄漏率。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong agent-security architecture that directly improves tool-use authorization, secret confinement, and production runtime governance.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项很强的智能体安全架构工作，直接提升了工具授权、秘密隔离和生产运行时治理能力。
